text: Actuators and positioners: pneumatic spring-return actuators with fail position on loss of air and signal as on the P&ID; sized for the maximum differential pressure of the closed valve with a margin of 25 % at the minimum air supply pressure; digital positioners with HART and diagnostics; full stroke time 10 s or less for control valves (3 s or less for the turbine bypass and spray-water attemperation valves, subject to the TCS supplier), stroke time and fail position stated in the datasheet.
